dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale gray-white edges on the folded flight feathers provide high contrast against the darker gray-brown feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct linear boundary is visible separating the solid dark-brown plumage of the crown from the heavily scaled pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad, dark malar stripe extending from the eye/bill region down the side of the throat, contrasting against a pale buff-white cheek.
